description: Sends your finished work on a card back to TabTree, ON that card, for the user's approval: the deliverable becomes a 📄 entry under the card (its note holds your result, in Markdown), with optional next-step sub-tasks, and the card can move to another column (e.g. "Review"). Nothing is written until the user approves it in TabTree — one banner, one click, Cmd+Z undoes it. Use it after card_prompt, once the deliverable is ready. Never put a password, key or token in it.

card.description: The card's id from card_prompt (or its exact text).

file.description: The map, as card_prompt named it.

move_to.description: Optional: a column of the board the card should move to once the user approves (its name, e.g. "Review").

note.description: Optional: one line shown on TabTree's banner.

result.description: The deliverable itself, in Markdown — what the user asked the card to produce. 30000 characters max; a long one is stored in parts.

subtasks.description: Optional: the next steps left to the user, one per item — they become unticked sub-tasks of the card. 20 at most.

title.description: Optional: a short name for the deliverable, e.g. "Pricing sheet structure" (default "Result from Claude"). 120 characters max.

name: deliver_card
